decisions.reason: Ticket and commission generation for no-referral mints does not alter which submitted referral codes are valid or the self-referral rule.
The existing revenue state already allocates a $5 commission per primary mint and excludes secondary sales from that primary-mint allocation; the source does not change the split.
The direct-referral commission remains one $5 payout triggered by use of a valid referral code; the source addresses missing random no-referral allocations instead.
Per-mint commission and ticket accounting does not change the single-level referral depth.
The source does not change the rule that an NFT's permanent referral code is its mint number.
Commission and ticket allocation does not change the NFT ebook asset type, unlimited supply, price, or edition identifier.
